config.title: Harbor Agents
config.language.description: Plugin UI language. Auto follows the VS Code display language.
config.fontSize.description: Panel font size in pixels (chat messages and composer).
config.baseUrl.description: Legacy mirror of the primary provider baseUrl (prefer agentPanel.providers)
config.apiKey.description: Legacy mirror of the primary provider apiKey (prefer agentPanel.providers). Do not commit keys to git.
config.providers.description: OpenAI-compatible providers (base URL + API key). If empty, built from legacy baseUrl/apiKey.
config.providers.id.description: Stable provider id (for example: default, zai, kimi)
config.providers.statusUrl.description: Optional connection check URL (GET). Empty = Base URL + /models
config.models.description: List of models available in the agent panel (id as in /openai/models)
config.models.id.description: Model id sent to the API
config.models.contextWindow.description: Model context window in tokens (max input). Also accepts max_input_tokens, maxInputTokens, context_length, and similar aliases.
config.models.maxOutputTokens.descriptio: Model max output tokens. Also accepts max_output_tokens, max_completion_tokens, and similar aliases.
config.models.enabled.description: Show model in the chat selector
config.models.favorite.description: Favorite model shown higher in the chat selector
config.models.supportsVision.description: Model accepts images (vision). If omitted, inferred from id
config.models.reasoningEffort.descriptio: Default reasoning effort for thinking models (low, medium, high, xhigh). Empty = auto from model capabilities.
config.defaultModel.description: Default model (must match an id from agentPanel.models)
config.defaultContextWindow.description: Default context window in tokens when a model has no contextWindow
config.modes.description: Custom composer modes (Agent/Plan/Ask are built in). Each item: { id, label, description?, tools: "agent"|"readonly", prompt?, enabled? }
config.maxToolRounds.description: Deprecated. Chat turns no longer use this Harbor limit — the agent runtime manages iteration budget itself.
config.maxToolRounds.deprecation: Unused for chat. Iteration limits are owned by the agent runtime.
config.visionRouting.preferredModelIds.d: Preferred vision models when the chat model cannot view images (and for Figma screenshots). First enabled match wins.
config.visionRouting.preferredModelId.de: Deprecated. Use agentPanel.visionRouting.preferredModelIds (also unused for chat turns).
config.maxResponseChars.description: Maximum chat response length; longer output is truncated. Repetitive loops are also trimmed.
config.soundNotifications.enabled.descri: Play a sound when an agent run succeeds or fails.
config.subagents.enabled.description: Allow parallel sub-agents (spawn_agent) in Agent, Plan, and Ask. When on, the model is instructed to delegate independent work via spawn_agent; when off, the tool is unavailable. Children follow the current mode: Plan/Ask stay read-focused; Agent may edit.
config.parallelToolCalls.enabled.descrip: Execute multiple tool calls from one model response at the same time (reads, searches, and other independent tools).
config.autoCompact.enabled.description: Automatically compress conversation context when it approaches the model input limit.
config.tools.autoApprove.description: Run agent tools without asking. Off — confirm each tool (edit, terminal, MCP) before it runs.
config.checkpoints.enabled.description: Save a git checkpoint at the start of each agent run so you can restore workspace files from the chat.
config.skills.enabled.description: Allow Agent Skills (SKILL.md) from Harbor skill folders. When off, the skills tool is unavailable.
config.skills.extraDirectories.descripti: Extra absolute directories to scan for skills (in addition to Harbor workspace and global folders).
config.skills.disabledExtraDirectories.d: Extra skill directories that are toggled off in Settings.
config.skills.disabled.description: Skill names to exclude from the skills tool (frontmatter name or directory name).
config.tabAutocomplete.enabled.descripti: Prefetch Tab suggestions while typing (ghost text stays hidden). Press Ctrl+Enter (⌘⏎ on macOS) to show, then Tab to accept. Uses your Harbor providers only — choose a dedicated model below. Prefer coder models. Disable any standalone TabCoder extension to avoid conflicts. Alt+[ / Alt+] = cycle alternatives; Ctrl+Right (Alt+Right on macOS) = next word; Ctrl+Down (Alt+Down) = next line.
config.tabAutocomplete.modelId.descripti: Model id from agentPanel.models used for Tab autocomplete (separate from the chat model). Coder models usually work better than chat/flash models.
config.tabAutocomplete.aggressiveness.de: How eagerly Tab autocomplete requests suggestions while you type.
config.tabAutocomplete.aggressiveness.en: High — faster suggestions, more API calls
config.tabAutocomplete.alternatives.desc: How many distinct ghost-text alternatives to request in one API call. Cycle with Alt+[ / Alt+]; Tab accepts the current one.
config.tabAutocomplete.excludeGlobs.desc: Glob patterns for files where Tab autocomplete stays silent (e.g. **/dist/**, **/*generated*). One pattern per entry. Clear the list to allow all paths (hard skips like .env / binaries still apply).
config.tabAutocomplete.nextEdit.descript: After accepting a Tab suggestion, show a Next chip at the likely following edit (e.g. new store → events section). Tab jumps there; Esc dismisses. Off by default.
config.tabAutocomplete.showMode.descript: How Tab shows suggestions. Chip = prefetch silently, press Ctrl+Enter / ⌘⏎ to preview. Inline = show ghost text automatically when ready.
config.tabAutocomplete.showMode.enum.chi: Chip — silent prefetch, Ctrl+Enter / ⌘⏎ to show
config.tabAutocomplete.fim.description: Use fill-in-the-middle (/completions with prompt+suffix) when the provider supports it. Falls back to hole-fill chat on failure. Off by default.
config.selectionHints.enabled.descriptio: Show floating Add to Chat actions above the selected code in the editor.
config.rejectUnauthorized.description: Validate TLS certificates. Off (default) works without a CA bundle behind corporate proxies. On = strict verify using the system trust store.
config.commitMessage.prompt.description: Custom rule/prompt for SCM commit message generation. Empty = use project rules, then the built-in default.
config.commitMessage.modelId.description: Model id from agentPanel.models for commit message generation. Empty = automatic light/utility model.
config.figma.enabled.description: Enable Figma MCP tools in Harbor Agents (Connect in panel Settings → MCP Servers)
config.autoglm.enabled.description: Enable browser_task (AutoGLM) for multi-step work in the user's Chrome/Edge. Requires AutoGLM CLI and browser extension.
config.autoglm.binaryPath.description: Optional path to the autoglm binary. Empty = PATH, then ~/.agents/skills/autoglm-browser-agent/dist/autoglm-browser-service.
config.autoglm.browser.description: Browser for AutoGLM tasks (chrome or edge)
config.autoglm.autoApprove.description: Auto-approve sensitive AutoGLM actions (login/captcha still require the user)
config.mcp.servers.description: Custom MCP servers (stdio or HTTP). Manage them in Harbor Agents Settings → MCP Servers.
